caption: The drawing shows two clear glass bottles, side by side, on a plain, light beige background. Both bottles are light blue-green in color, with long necks and wide, rounded bases that narrow gradually as they reach the neck. The bottle on the left has a depiction of a bird in flight, possibly an eagle, with wings spread wide and a banner or ribbon beneath it. The bottle on the right displays a decorative label area with an ornate border, containing an indistinct design that appears to include a face-like shape at the top and a smaller banner at the bottom with the letters "U MIDS" or similar text. Both bottles have embossed detailing on their surfaces. There is no additional scenery or objects; the drawing focuses solely on the two bottles and their details. The artist's signature and the year 1940 appear at the lower right corner.
title: Green Whiskey Bottle
